name: Crab, Muck, Titan
body:
Muck Crab Titan
CR 11

XP 12,800
N Colossal vermin
Init -1; Senses darkvision 60 ft., Perception +0

DEFENSE

AC 23, touch 1, flat-footed 23 (-1 Dex, +22 nature, -8 size)
hp 189 (14d8+126)
Fort +18, Ref +4, Will +4
Immune mind-affecting effects

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft., swim 20 ft.
Melee 2 claws +17 (2d8+15 plus grab)
Special Attacks constrict (2d8+15)
Space 30 ft.; Reach 30 ft.

STATISTICS

STR 40, Dex 9, Con 28, Int -, Wis 10, Cha 1
Base Attack +10; CMB +33 (+36 grapple), CMD 42 (58 vs. trip)
Skills Stealth -9 (-5 in muddy or swampy terrain), Swim +8; Racial Modifiers +4 Stealth in muddy or swampy terrain
SQ amphibious

ECOLOGY

Environment edges of lakes and rivers, swamps, muddy coastlines (but really, how would you hide this?)
Organization solitary or caste (2 – 12)
Treasure solitary (because how could there be more than one?)

Why is that muddy island moving?!

It is incredibly improbable that a muck crab could have survived long enough to get this big, but here we are.
